resources.string: Can\'t start OneKuku? Works without WiFi
Core component missing; follow prep flow to install

PC-free setup (install Termux + pkg install android-tools):
1) On the wireless-debug page tap "Pair device with pairing code", note IP:pair-port and the code;
2) In Termux run: adb pair localhost:pair-port code
3) Then run: adb connect localhost:connect-port
4) Start OneKuku core per the prep guide

OneKuku core activation (wireless debugging + ADB; Termux works without a PC):
1) Enable Wireless debugging in Developer options
2) Tap "Pair device with pairing code" and note the pair-port and code
3) In Termux (pkg install android-tools) run:
 adb pair localhost:pair-port code
4) Then: adb connect localhost:connect-port
5) Start core:
 %1$s
6) Return to OneIMS and tap Activate OneKuku to grant access

Note: You do not need the Play Store third-party channel app; the core is bundled or downloaded from the official source by OneIMS.
